title: 以前 and 以后 in Chinese: "Before" and "After" (HSK 3 Grammar)
description: How to use 以前 (yǐqián) and 以后 (yǐhòu) for "before", "after", "ago" and "in the future" in Chinese: word order, 以后 vs 后来, mistakes and HSK 3 examples.
h1: How to Say "Before" and "After" with 以前 and 以后
lede: 以前 (yǐqián) means "before" and 以后 (yǐhòu) means "after". On their own they mean "in the past" and "in the future". After an action or a time, they mean "before..." and "after...", but the word order is the opposite of English.

sections.h2: On their own: "in the past" and "in the future"
paras: 以前 on its own means "before", "in the past" or "used to". 以后 on its own means "later" or "in the future". Like other time words, they go at the start of the sentence or right after the subject.

examples.py: Yǐqián wǒ bù xǐhuan chī yú.
examples.en: I didn't use to like fish.
I used to be a teacher.

examples.py: Yǐhòu wǒ xiǎng qù Zhōngguó gōngzuò.
examples.en: In the future I'd like to work in China.

sections.h2: Action or time + 以前 / 以后
paras: Action or time + 以前 / 以后.

To say "before eating" or "after class", the action comes first and 以前 or 以后 comes after it: 吃饭以前, 下课以后. The most common mistake is to follow English word order and say 以前吃饭. The same goes for clock times: 十点以后 is "after ten o'clock".

examples.py: Chī fàn yǐqián yào xǐ shǒu.
examples.en: You should wash your hands before you eat.

examples.zh: 下课以后，我们去打篮球吧。
examples.py: Xiàkè yǐhòu, wǒmen qù dǎ lánqiú ba.
examples.en: Let's go and play basketball after class.

examples.zh: 晚上十点以后别给我打电话。
examples.py: Wǎnshang shí diǎn yǐhòu bié gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà.
examples.en: Don't call me after ten at night.

paras: After a length of time, 以前 means "ago" and 以后 means "in... time" or "later". In speech you will also hear the short forms 前 and 后: 三天前, 睡觉前.

examples.zh: 三年以前，我开始学汉语。
examples.py: Sān nián yǐqián, wǒ kāishǐ xué Hànyǔ.
examples.en: I started learning Chinese three years ago.

examples.py: Tā liǎng ge xīngqī yǐhòu huílai.
examples.en: He'll be back in two weeks.

paras: On its own, 以后 looks forward to the future. To say "later" or "after that" when you tell a story about the past, Chinese usually uses 后来 (hòulái) instead.

examples.zh: 他去年来过我家，后来我们就没有见过面。
examples.py: Tā qùnián lái guo wǒ jiā, hòulái wǒmen jiù méiyǒu jiàn guo miàn.
examples.en: He came to my place last year, but we haven't seen each other since.

worksheet.title: 以前 and 以后 Worksheet: HSK 3 Printable with Answers
worksheet.description: A free printable 以前 and 以后 worksheet for HSK 3: 17 exercises (choose 以前 or 以后, word order, fix the mistake) with an answer key.

exercises.h2: Choose 以前 or 以后
exercises.instructions: Write 以前 or 以后 in each gap. The English tells you what the sentence means.

items.en: Let's wash our hands before we eat.
After work I'm going to the supermarket.
I used to be fat, but now I'm thin.

items.zh: 五年＿＿，我来到了这个城市。
items.en: I came to this city five years ago.
He's going back to his country in a month.
Don't play on your phone before you go to sleep.
After my exams, I'd like to go travelling.
If you have any questions in future, you can call me.
There didn't use to be an underground line here.
I'm at home from eight o'clock onwards, so come over.

exercises.instructions: Write the words as one correct sentence.

items.en: I often read before going to sleep.
We'll go to the library after class.
answers: 下课以后我们去图书馆。
我们下课以后去图书馆。

items.en: I'd like to go to China in a year's time.
This used to be a shop.

exercises.instructions: Each sentence has one mistake. Write the correct sentence.

items.en: I came here two years ago.
Don't forget to turn off the lights before you go out.
He'll be back in three days.
